verses.english: “There are these two kinds of support.
Support in things of the flesh and support in the teaching.
These are the two kinds of support.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ anuggahānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammānuggaho”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of support is support in the teaching.”
